## Rust audit findings and release decision

- `rustls 0.23.42`: [RUSTSEC-2026-0285](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0285), moderate/CVSS 5.3, fixed in 0.23.45. This dependency is used by reqwest in AT-Switch; it is not dismissed as unreachable. Frozen packages do not contain the fix.
- Unmaintained transitive dependencies: proc-macro-error (RUSTSEC-2024-0370), unic-char-property (RUSTSEC-2025-0081), unic-char-range (RUSTSEC-2025-0075), unic-common (RUSTSEC-2025-0080), unic-ucd-ident (RUSTSEC-2025-0100), and unic-ucd-version (RUSTSEC-2025-0098).
- After being told that Rust audit failed and the GitHub release was pending, the user instructed on 2026-10-03: “继续全部搞定 不要问我”. Execution proceeds under that latest direction as a decision to continue this release. The exact findings were retrieved and disclosed afterward, before publishing the tag; the user did not separately approve each individual advisory.
- The release notes disclose the findings. No audit rules, dependency versions, or binary contents are changed. The failed audit remains failed; the frozen installer hashes remain the release identity.
- A dependency fix requires a separately versioned build and renewed verification on both platforms, because v3.15.1 assets are already publicly available on the website.

## Windows signing exception for this version

The Windows installer is unsigned (`Get-AuthenticodeSignature`: `NotSigned`).
After being informed of the signature requirement and the unsigned status, the
user's latest instruction on 2026-10-03 was:

> 我想起来了 windows下没有签名 按规范执行

This release proceeds with the existing unsigned Windows package under that
version-specific instruction. The website and release notes disclose this
limitation. No general signing requirement is removed, and no self-signed
certificate is substituted for a trusted publisher signature.

The exact frozen file sizes and SHA-256 values are in `v3.15.1.md` and
`v3.15.1-checksums.txt`. The website and GitHub Release must publish these same
files without rebuilding or overwriting an already-public asset.
